WITH route AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-104.848585 39.697902, -104.847904 39.698274, -104.847504 39.698271, -104.847502 39.69875, -104.847499 39.699152, -104.847511 39.699195, -104.847534 39.699229, -104.847551 39.699263, -104.847553 39.699377)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, ST_Envelope(r.geom))) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, route r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
segments AS (
  SELECT (ST_DumpSegments(r.geom)).geom AS seg
  FROM route r
),
endpoints AS (
  SELECT
    ST_StartPoint(seg) AS p1,
    ST_EndPoint(seg)   AS p2,
    ST_Length(seg::geography) AS seg_len_m
  FROM segments
),
elev AS (
  SELECT
    e.seg_len_m,
    ST_Value(dc.rast, 1, e.p1) AS z1,
    ST_Value(dc.rast, 1, e.p2) AS z2
  FROM endpoints e, dem_clip dc
),
slopes AS (
  SELECT
    seg_len_m,
    CASE WHEN seg_len_m > 0 THEN ABS(z2 - z1) / seg_len_m ELSE NULL END AS grade
  FROM elev
  WHERE z1 IS NOT NULL AND z2 IS NOT NULL
),
avg_grade AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(grade * seg_len_m) / NULLIF(SUM(seg_len_m), 0) AS g
  FROM slopes
  WHERE grade IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DEGREES(ATAN(g)) AS slope_degrees
FROM avg_grade;

WITH road_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('LINESTRING (-104.848585 39.697902, -104.847904 39.698274, -104.847504 39.698271, -104.847502 39.69875, -104.847499 39.699152, -104.847511 39.699195, -104.847534 39.699229, -104.847551 39.699263, -104.847553 39.699377)', 4326)::geometry AS geom
),
raster_slope AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(
        r.rast, 
        true, 
        (SELECT geom FROM road_geom)
      ), 
      1, 
      '32BF'
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(
      r.rast, 
      (SELECT geom FROM road_geom)
    )
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(value), 2) AS average_slope_degrees
FROM 
  raster_slope s,
  LATERAL ST_DumpAsPolygons(s.slope_rast, true) AS (geom geometry, value double precision)
WHERE 
  geom && (SELECT geom FROM road_geom)
  AND ST_Intersects(geom, (SELECT geom FROM road_geom));
